content: GitHub Actions Postgres service-container pattern for CI smoke tests: define a postgres: image: postgres:16 service with env POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB, port mapping 5432:5432, and options health-cmd pg_isready with retries so the runner waits for readiness before the job proceeds. On GitHub-hosted runners the service is reached via 127.0.0.1 (not the service label) since the job runs directly on the runner, not in a container.
